scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:functions
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/web run test && npm --prefix functions run test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix functions run lint
scripts.deploy:web: npm --prefix apps/web run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy --only functions
